About_Us.desc:
Smart File Aide is a straightforward tool designed to help you organize your device's internal storage and quickly locate your files.
Key Features:
Storage Overview & Quick Access: Check your storage usage at a glance and browse files automatically categorized by type
Recent Files Management: Easily view and track recently added files
Storage Cleanup: Free up space using dedicated tools to find and delete Similar Photos, Screenshots, Big Files, Empty Folders, and Useless Files
File Details: View specific file paths, sizes, and editing dates
Safe & Starred Folders: Keep sensitive files hidden in the Safe Folder or mark important ones for quick access
